name: s81dv_idxrg-s81dv_idxrg-COMMIT
purpose: S81-DV p4l regional index reader/scorer dsdv_idx_rg (x16 a die, MU.BAL.SX.3 release blocker) to closure (TT setup / FF hold / DRC 0 + native audit).

bench.name: lint
bench.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN} && printf '%s\n' 'module ot_lint_top; dsdv_idx_rg #(.SRAM_MACRO(1)) u_top (); endmodule' > {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv && verilator --lint-only -Wno-fatal -Wno-lint -Wno-style -Wno-TIMESCALEMOD -Wno-MULTIDRIVEN -Wno-MODMISSING -DSYNTHESIS --top-module ot_lint_top {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv rtl/hdc/ot_hdc_fastfp.sv rtl/hdc/ot_hdc_delay.sv rtl/hdc/v41x/ot_hdc_v41x_idx_arith.sv rtl/hdc/v41x/ot_hdc_v41x_idx.sv rtl/dsrom_sys/s81_dv/idx/dsdv_idx_rg.sv physical/asap7_memory_macros/ot_sram_1r1w_256x256_m2_r2c2/ot_sram_1r1w_256x256_m2_r2c2_bb.v && echo lint-ok

bench.name: idxrd_base
bench.note: operating points measured 10-19 on RTL 4cc3975d1 (bench HBM model, refresh-aware): scan P=3 PASS L2/L20 (P=2 FAILs fail-closed even at T0 3000: HBM-bound), gather P=4 PASS (P=3 FAIL)

bench.name: idxrd_mut1
bench.note: MUT 1: lane hash off by one

bench.name: idxrd_mut2
bench.note: MUT 2: rk always returned to the slice

bench.name: idxrd_mut3
bench.note: MUT 3: scale sector of the neighbouring cell

bench.name: idxrd_mut4
bench.note: MUT 4: region 0 part-1 beat one cycle late

calibrate.reason: ref_tile: boundary referenced in-run to the propagated tree (io_ref_skew.sdc), as the Qwen die masters

route.cmd: export OT_TTB_CORNER_MARK={CL}/ttb_corner.txt && python3 tools/closure_loop/tt_overlay.py {SRC} && export OT_CTS_FIX_HOOKS='physical/common_flow/cg_pushdown.tcl physical/common_flow/clk_net_protect.tcl physical/common_flow/link_budget_hook.tcl'; export OT_ORFS_CORNER_OVERRIDE=TC; HM=0.03 OT_MM_FF_SDC='physical/ref_tile/s81dv_idxrg/signoff_ffrepair.sdc' SRC={SRC} OT_PIN_GROUP_MAX=32 bash tools/ref_tile/ref_route.sh physical/ref_tile/s81dv_idxrg/kit.env {LABEL} {RUN}/routes

collect.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/record/route {RUN}/record/views && cp {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/corner_sta.json {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/status {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/STATUS {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/signoff.sdc {RUN}/record/route/ && python3 tools/ref_tile/ref_tile.py export --orfs-dir {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/work/orfs --kit physical/ref_tile/s81dv_idxrg --out {RUN}/record/views/dsdv_idx_rg --macro-view physical/asap7_memory_macros/ot_sram_1r1w_256x256_m2_r2c2 > {RUN}/record/route/export.log 2>&1

budget.reason: ref_tile: boundary budget 0.2 T applied in-run

structural_change: S81-IDXRD (MU.BAL.SX.3, release blocker): NEW element. p4l (bind9) has no index reader/scorer; this is the regional reader x16 (one per dsfd_ctrl_rg2 region), a station on the region's rq/rd link, exact engine ot_hdc_v41x_idx_engine NK 1, selector-native BK beats on a neighbour-only score chain into dsdv_bk_sel.
